_comment: Go-live overrides (2026-10-07). Conservative daily MON caps while testnet MON is scarce. Live state lives OUTSIDE ~/Documents (launchd jobs cannot read ~/Documents: macOS privacy/TCC), in the runtime copy ~/isotherm-live made by scripts/deploy-runtime.sh. Both the repo copy and the runtime copy point at the same absolute var paths, so the single-writer lock covers both. See docs/OPERATIONS.md. Maker cap 0.8 + reserve 0.2 per Taipei day so that cap + reserve + the close-time kill switch (~0.26) always fit in the maker's MON (it held 1.73 after go-live funding).
